# Karmatix .NET Academy
> "Learn .NET the clear way."
> Published by Karmatix (https://karmatix.in). Target: .NET 10 LTS & C# 14.

## Overview
Karmatix .NET Academy is a free, commercial-grade educational curriculum designed to train software engineers from zero programming knowledge to job-ready cloud engineers.

## Structure
- Modules 0 to 11 (C# Fundamentals, OOP, Async/Parallelism, EF Core, ASP.NET Core, Security, Clean Architecture, Docker, DevOps, MAUI/Blazor, Capstones).
- 16 Tested Compilable Sample Projects in `/samples/KarmatixDotNetAcademy.sln`.
- Career Hub: 200+ Interview Questions, 50+ Coding Problems, 6 Timed Mock Exams.
- Certifications Guide: AZ-204, AZ-900, Microsoft Foundational C#, Applied Skills.
- Free Resource Library: 39 verified official books, documentation, and tools.
- Privacy & DPDP Act: 100% client-side, zero trackers, zero cookies, local storage only.
